brief: Intro paragraph — retinol alternatives for sensitive skin (req_agent_niacinamide_barrier_after40 family)
a: If retinol leaves your skin red and flaking, you are not doing it wrong — your barrier is telling you something. After 40, the skin's tolerance for aggressive actives narrows, and the good news is that the alternatives are no longer second-best.
b: Retinol is the gold standard — but gold standards assume an average skin, and yours may not be average. For sensitive skin past 40, three well-studied alternatives now deliver comparable resurfacing evidence without the irritation tax.
